Container.Name: Enable-Actual
Container.Overview:
Enable Actual imports transactions from European banks into Actual Budget through Enable Banking (official PSD2 APIs, free for personal use, read-only access to your accounts). A web UI handles setup, account mapping, import schedules and history, with optional ntfy notifications.
Image tag: the Actual client bundled in the image must be the same version as your Actual Budget server or newer. Set the tag to your Actual server version, e.g. 2manyvcos/enable-actual:actual26.10.0 for Actual 26.10.0, and change it each time you update Actual. latest always ships the newest Actual client: only keep it if your Actual server is always up to date.
First launch: set Public URL to the exact address you open the UI with (e.g. https://192.168.1.10:3000), since the UI calls the API through it. Open that address and follow the setup: Enable Banking application (redirect URL: PUBLIC_URL/enablebanking/callback), Actual Budget server (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:5006), account mapping and schedule.
HTTPS is required by Enable Banking: SSL is on by default with a self-signed certificate (expect a browser warning). There is no built-in authentication: never expose the port to the internet, use a reverse proxy with authentication if you need remote access.
Container.Requires:
The container runs as user 1001:1001 (no PUID/PGID). Before the first start, create the appdata folder with the right owner from the Unraid terminal:
mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/enable-actual chown -R 1001:1001 /mnt/user/appdata/enable-actual
The image tag must match your Actual Budget server version or be newer (see Overview).

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Settings, import history and Actual cache (owner 1001:1001)

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Address you open the UI with, e.g. https://192.168.1.10:3000 (also the Enable Banking redirect base)

Config.Name: SSL_ENABLED
Config.Description: Serve HTTPS with a self-signed certificate (false behind a reverse proxy that handles HTTPS)

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Internal listen port (must match WebUI Port container port)

Config.Name: SSL_CERTIFICATE_FILE
Config.Description: Your own certificate, path inside the container (e.g. /data/cert.pem); set with SSL_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE

Config.Name: SSL_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE
Config.Description: Private key of your own certificate, path inside the container (e.g. /data/key.pem)

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log level: none, info or debug

Config.Name: HISTORY_LENGTH
Config.Description: Number of import history entries kept
